<p>So, after this frustrating experience I did two things:<br>
1. I turned to the Internet to see what I could find about the price of Meltwater.<br>
2. I (begrudgingly) booked a call with a Meltwater sales representative.</p>
<p>Here’s what I managed to find out about Meltwater pricing.</p>
<h2 id="tldr">TL;DR</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>The Meltwater price and packages are all custom.</strong> Be prepared to sit through several sales calls if you want to get a straight answer or a quote.</li>
<li><strong>Some <a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/PublicRelations/comments/mr0939/comment/gujegcr/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x&context=3">users on Reddit</a> mention that there is flexibility for you to negotiate the price</strong> <strong>you are quoted</strong> to something more reasonable. This info is also aligned with what I experienced when talking to the sales rep. When she gave me a ballpark figure, I said it was out of my budget. And she mentioned that they might be able to find a way to adjust things slightly.</li>
<li><strong>The number she quoted me, by the way, was $15,000.</strong> And no, that’s not a typo. This was for 4 user accounts and a total of 16 social media profiles and ONLY included the social media management and social listening packages – nothing else.</li>
</ul>
<p>Meltwater users complain about the pricing as well. Dozens of<a href="https://www.g2.com/products/meltwater/reviews?utf8=%E2%9C%93&filters%5Bcomment_answer_values%5D=price"> G2 reviews from real Meltwater users</a> seem to indicate that the cost of Meltwater just isn’t worth it.</p>

<h2 id="what-users-like-about-meltwater">What Users Like About Meltwater</h2>
<p>The social media management platform itself does have some pretty useful features, though many of them are more geared towards PR and corporate communication professionals, rather than social media marketers.</p>
<p>Some of these features include things like:</p>
<ul>
<li>Media and contact database of journalists and influencers for outreach</li>
<li>Access to a lot of data from across nearly every channel, including traditional print and broadcast media, for better consumer and sales intelligence</li>
<li>Boolean search tools for highly specialized listening queries</li>
</ul>
<p>It’s not a bad platform. It’s just not for everyone.</p>
<h2 id="who-is-meltwater-ideal-for">Who Is Meltwater Ideal for?</h2>
<p>That being said, Meltwater could still potentially be a good fit for you if:</p>
<ul>
<li>You are an enterprise company that needs to track media mentions across not only social media but also traditional news outlets and Asian platforms as well.</li>
<li>You don’t care about the price and don’t mind needing to purchase frequent add-ons to get access to features</li>
<li>You are really into using Boolean search.</li>
</ul>
<p>If that doesn’t sound like you, you might want to consider something else for your social media management tool.</p>
<h2 id="when-meltwater-may-not-be-for-you">When Meltwater May Not Be for You</h2>
<p>Also, keep in mind that Meltwater probably isn’t an ideal solution for people who:</p>
<ul>
<li>Need to assign different roles and publishing permissions to different users</li>
<li>Need to publish Youtube shorts or FB Reels</li>
<li>Need a tool with Instagram grid view</li>
<li>Need something user-friendly and intuitive</li>
</ul>
<p>Ultimately, the best choice depends on your unique business needs and budget. But if you want a solution that actually does have those features, my suggestion would be to check out Agorapulse.</p>
